sub6006: This story begins with Emily a girl who is struggling with a breakup
and now faces the one month anniversary of the breakup itself.
As she hears the golden retriever and the loud alarm clock that marks the one month anniversary. Emily wakes up
and presses the snooze button.
She feels sad for the situation she is in.
Emily feels a touch at the end of her bed
it is a teddy bear that was given to her by Adam her ex.
Many things reminded Emily of Adam in the room.
The keyboard where they used to play together and many other objects that were important.
Emily not knowing if she was hungry or sick decided to go to the kitchen
there she opened the fridge where on the top shelf there was another thing that reminded her of Adam.
Chinese takeout.
It was expired of course.
Emily just went to bed again where she was reached by Lex her best friend.
Lex called Emily wishing a happy breakout anniversary
but Emily just felt sad
and hung up.
Lex called her again and said Emily needed some comfort and a schedule of different things to do on that day.
Lex said she would come to Emily's house so she could pick her up.
After a while Emily heard something hitting her window.
Its Emily standing near her car waiting for Emily.
Without any consideration for her looks and with a pony sweater Emily came down and met Lex.
She asked what was going up and what was she throwing.
Emily grabbed what seemed to be M&Ms.
Lex told Emily that her day started today with the goal to forget Adam
and since M&Ms contained peanuts it reminded Emily that Adam was allergic to peanuts.
Lex helped Emily get dressed to go out.
Emily chose a white dress
and they both agreed to go to the salon.
Upon reaching the salon Emily agreed to paint her nails green as the grass.
Upon leaving the salon Emily felt like she was having a crisis
and sat down.
Lex came next to her
and touched her face
Lex's palm was all baby blue.
Emily just figured she sat near the chalk walk
and her white dress was ruined.
Lex and Emily agreed to got to the shopping to purchase some new clothes for Emily.
After entering the shopping Emily discussed that she preferred to enter the off brand store as the other store was frequented by Adam.
Upon entering the clothing store Lex just figured that Adam was there
and Emily went to hide.
She watched him from afar like a stalker as Lex said to Emily.
Lex wanted for Emily to go talk to Adam
in which Emily refused at first but then tried to go talk to him
but he disappeared.
Confused they both went to the nearby coffee place
that was a famous college hub.
Emily was not very fond of the place as it was where she had first met Adam.
Nearby there was a guy who called upon Emily.
Surprised she did not know who that was.
The guy was pointing to another woman
and wanted Emily to record  video of them.
He took out an instrument and on his knees started playing Marriage by Train in front of this girl.
Emily afraid to screw this up
she noticed that a pug wanted to go near them but was afraid that might interfere with the video she was recording.
The pug came out near the guy with a ring on his collar where he then placed upon her hand.
They were both very happy and all the cafe cheered for them.
The guy thanked Emily.
Lex mentioned that Emily's breakup anniversary was another persons happy anniversary.
Lex and Emily went out to order something to drink at the cafe.
Lex got distracted
and started talking with some sorority girls she stumbled upon and left Emily to order.
Emily noticed the barista
a guy with muscles and a lot of tattoos.
She goes to check his name tag.
Ryan.
Emily had trouble ordering something
and managed to order 2 house specials.
As she was about to reach for her wallet she remembered she had her nails done
and was afraid to break them.
Emily asked for Lex to help her
but Lex said she needed practice.
So she asked Ryan for help
he grabbed her purse and took out her wallet
paid with credit card and returned everything to Emily.
Upon returning the receipt to Emily she accidentally breaks her nail and slashes Ryans hand.
There was blood on the floor
and Emily felt sorry.
She tried to tip him 20 bucks
but he refused and said that it was fine.
He mentioned he had suffered worse on his football games.
Lex returned to Emily and surprised said that she can't be gone for 2 minutes.
Lex mentioned she needed to go back home to finish a school project in the next hours or she could be deducted 10 percent.
Emily agreed to let her go and call her later.
They both hug and Lex leaves.
Emily sits on the coffee table
and Ryan shows up with the 2 house specials.
One of the drinks had a smiley face on them.
Both Emily and Ryan talked for some time until a group of customers came in
and Ryan had to get back to work.
Emily left and met up with Lex later.
Lex mentioned there was going to be a sorority party in the sorority house
and she wanted Emily to come.
Emily agreed and they both went out.
The house seemed like the normal sorority house with big roman numerals, sticky floor, beer pong, and red plastic cups everywhere.
Lex meets up with one of her friends who recognizes Emily.
Surprised Emily wondered how she knew until the girl mentioned Emily was Adam's girlfriend in which Emily corrected ex-girlfriend.
The girl told Emily a secret that involved Lex not approving of her relationship with Adam a while back.
Emily seemed furious
and confronted Lex after playing a card game with her
but all was talked out in the end.
Lex mentioned she was eyeing someone in the party for Emily to talk to.
Emily refused
and went to sit in the sofa in the corner.
She stood there for a while until Ryan showed up
and sat in front of her.
He did not expect to see her there
and Emily asked if this was his house.
He nodded and they both talked for some time.
Emily really enjoyed the conversation that time went by very fast.
Emily said she needed to get Lex home
who was already pretty drunk.
Ryan asked to help
and she agreed
they both get Lex in the car
and Emily writes her number to give to Ryan.
She says that she can help with the cleaning tomorrow
in which Ryan responds he doesn't mind.
Emily returns Lex to her house
and lays her down on her couch
she then goes home.
She pulls out a box she has in her closet and opens it up.
and she is seeing memories in front of her.
Now Emily has a dilemma in her hands if she lets go of her past to start anew or carry on her past.
She chooses to live with her past
and keeps her memories in the box
and reconciles herself with playing the piano.
She now feels better and hopeful for the coming times.
The End.
sub6025: I remember the story began with my alarm ringing at 10 am in the morning disrupting a dream about my childhood.
I'm reminded that it has been a month since I broke with my ex boyfriend Adam
whom i had been dating for two years.
I snooze the alarm
and turn away to see a pile of crumpled tissues from the night before.
I discover that a stuffed teddy bear that Adam had gifted me had ended up in my bed.
My attention is then grabbed by a piano that Adam and I used to play.
It reminds me of the good times we had together.
I decide to wash the dishes.
I head for the kitchen
open the fridge
and discover expired take outs from the night of the break up
and dump them in the trash.
I then head to the bedroom to give my best friend Lex a call.
She then decides to take me out after calling me out on my pity party.
5 minutes later she pulls up to fetch me.
She throws packets of peanut M&M's on my window.
I then make my way to her in my not so appealing outfit.
After calling her out on throwing the M&M's at my window and tasting the M&M's for the first time in two years due to Adam being allergic to peanuts we head inside to change my outfit.
I put on a white dress
and we head for Lex's favourite salon for a make-over.
I settle for a grass green colored manicure as suggested by Lex.
After convincing Lex that I do not want to get my hair done we head outside
and I sit on a park bench.
I realise that I had sat on sidewalk chalk
and needed to change my now strained dressed.
We make our way to the mall to buy another outfit.
We settle on a store with a bad fashion display over Adam's favourite shop to avoid bumping into Adam.
My gaze rests on Adam just as I was about to exit the store.
I notice the fact that he looks good despite the break up.
I then decide to hide behind a clothing rack
to avoid being seen by Adam.
After Lex convinces me to talk to him I finally come out
but get disappointed to find him gone.
We then head for Firefly Cafe to grab some coffee.
When we enter the Cafe a guy I know briefly from one of my classes asks me to take a recording of him and his girlfriend only for him to get down on his knee and propose.
The guy sings "Marry me" by Train whilst playing the ukulele.
The girl agrees to marry him.
I then open the door to the cafe for a dog who had been struggling to open it.
The dog heads to the guy with the ukulele.
The guy reaches for the dog's collar
and grabs a ring then slips it into his now fiance's finger.
I then end the recording
hand the phone back to the guy and congratulate him.
I then head to the counter to place an order when I notice the good looking barista.
I discover that his name is Ryan by observing his name tag.
I ring the bell to get his attention
but he does not notice me at first.
He only notices me after I clear my throat.
I then place an order for two daily specials.
Ryan made a comment about him not pegging me as a customer who would order a daily special
but processes my order anyways.
I then attempt to get my wallet that is buried deep inside my bag
but my manicure makes it hard to do so.
I head to Lex who is chatting with her sorority sister for assistance.
She refuses
and tells me to practice for next time.
I then opt to get Ryan to assist me.
He agrees
and pulls my wallet off my bag gets my card out and processes the payment for my order
and returns my things.
I then scratch his hand with my nail whilst trying to retrieve the receipt from him
and it bleeds.
I apologise and offer him a tip
but he refuses
and tells me not to worry myself about it.
I then discover that he plays soccer
and he invites me to a game.
I then head back to Lex who is now seating alone after being handed the table number.
We then chat about how good looking the barista is before Lex lets me know that she has to head back to her place to submit an assignment in the next 30 minutes to avoid being penalised.
She leaves after telling me to stop by her place in the next hour.
Ryan brings my order shortly after Lex leaves
and we chat shortly before a group enters the cafe.
This is when I discover that he plays soccer
and get invited to a game.
An hour passes and I head to Lex's place.
When I get to her place she does my makeup, gives me a dress to wear and we go to a party.
When we gat to the party one of her sorority sisters secretly tells me that Lex did not approve of my relationship with Adam.
I confront her
and she confirms that it was indeed true
and she thought I deserved better.
She makes a comment about how she thinks Ryan and I would look good together when we see him at the party.
I decide not to go to him after embarrassing myself at the coffee shop earlier on.
Ryan comes to me after I had been sitting alone for a while.
We chat
and I learn quite a few things about him.
He is afraid of needles, has a little sibling, and lives at this house.
We end up dancing until I notice Lex laying on a couch drunk.
I excuse myself
and let him know that I have to take Lex home.
When he offers to help me take Lex to the car I realise that he is more of a gentlemen than Adam was.
After helping me get Lex to the car I give him my number
and offer to help him clean up the place the following day
and drive off to my apartment.
I then lay Lex on the couch
and cover her in a blanket before heading for my bedroom.
I then grab a box of things I had been collecting over the 2 years that Adam and I were together.
I then decide to finally move on with my life
and put the box back on the shelf.
I finally bring my self to playing the piano after a month of not playing it.
